text:
laura_csm: Velox Dynamics dedicated pool bring-up tomorrow 08:30 PT. Need final quota, autoscale knobs, soak plan, and a 15-min enablement for their oncall. Who can join? :wave:

rick_infra: I'll take infra. Recommend reserve 8x A40, allow autoscale up to 12 for spikes. Will post estimated instance-hours in 20m.

erin_account: Velox confirmed 8 reserved if week1 cost delta < 16%. I'll share their finance contact and cc them on invites.

priya_sre: Autoscale rules proposal:
- scale out +1 when avg GPU util > 68% for 2m
- scale-out +2 if request queue > 700ms for 90s
- scale in -1 when util < 32% for 8m
- cooldown 3m, max 2 ops per 10m

marco_ml: Load mix for the soak: 50% chat (~1k tokens), 30% embeddings, 20% short-gen. Seeds: s3://velox/onboard/seeds-v1.txt

laura_csm: @marco_ml paste loadgen command and canary plan here.

marco_ml: loadgen cmd:
```
loadgen --target https://dedicated.redwood/velox --qps 160 --duration 3600 \\
  --profile mixed --seeds s3://velox/onboard/seeds-v1.txt --concurrency 48
```

rick_infra: I'll run prewarm 30m before start to compile kernels & populate KV. Prewarm command:
```
./ops/prewarm.sh --pool velox --minutes 30
```

schedule-bot: Provision event scheduled: 1789999800  velox-dedicated-provision

priya_sre: Canary: 1 instance handles 4% traffic for 6m, then 10m ramp to 25% before full. Fallback: route to hosted family if p95 > 2.6s for 3 consecutive mins. Also enable token-bucket shaping (burst window 300ms).

erin_account: I'll run the 08:00 PT enablement call for 15m with their SREs and send invites to velox-oncall@.

rick_infra: Will tag dashboards customer:velox env:dedicated and stream perf to #ops-dashboard. If 429s > 3% reduce qps by 20% and re-evaluate cache hit ratio.

laura_csm: Quick go/no-go check at 08:10 PT. Post-run feedback link: https://forms.redwood/bringup-feedback (2 min). Thanks team! :thumbsup:
